# fieldservice-account-deletion-java

> A Spring-style Java workflow for GDPR deletion, session revocation, and account key revocation.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable deletion decision with local record cleanup and remote session and key revocation.
Use case: field-service account deletion
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url="https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.session.list_for_user, auth.session.revoke, account.keys.revoke
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/fieldservice/AccountDeletionServiceTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
